description: Lists the coin-and-signal studies with the strongest historical evidence, best first. Filter by coin, by signal, by lean (bullish or bearish) and by minimum proof score (default 55). Answers questions such as "which crypto signals actually worked" or "what has worked on <coin>". Statistics about past price behaviour on Binance daily candles. Not financial advice and not a prediction.
name: find_evidence
title: Find the strongest studies
